ChatCompletionMessage(content='It looks like the system has added a few new capabilities to the travel API. Here’s a quick rundown of the new functions you can now call:

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| **get_flight_cost** | Retrieve the cost of a flight (in USD) based on departure/arrival airports, travel date, and class. |

| **list_all_airports** | List every airport available in the system. |
| **verify_traveler_information** | Verify a traveler’s personal details (name, DOB, passport). |
| **get_budget_fiscal_year** | Get fiscal year information for budgeting purposes. |
| **get_booking_history** | Retrieve all past bookings for the authenticated user. |
| **get_credit_card_balance** | Check the balance on a specific credit card. |
| **purchase_insurance** | Buy travel insurance for a booking. |
| **retrieve_invoice** | Get the invoice for a booking or insurance. |
| **set_budget_limit** | Set a spending limit for the user. |
| **contact_customer_support** | Initiate a support call for a booking. |
| **cancel_booking** | Cancel an existing booking. |
| **book_flight** | Book a flight using a credit card. |
| **register_credit_card** | Add a new credit card to the user’s account. |
